d: Speaking at IIM Bangalore during the inauguration of the Namma Metro Pink Line's 7.5-km elevated stretch on November 13, Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar called for stronger Centre-State partnership, stating, "Let us compete in politics, but collaborate in development." Highlighting that Bengaluru's operational metro network has crossed 103 km, Shivakumar outlined an ambitious target to expand it to 500 km to cut traffic congestion by half.
